newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says to auction 10-year JGBs on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says to auction 10-year JGBs on Tuesday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, a MOF official said on Monday.

Traders said the offer volume was likely to be unchanged from the last JGB auction at one trillion yen, but the coupon rate was likely to be lowered to 2.6 percent. The last auction of 10-year JGBs carried a record-low 2.7 percent coupon.
Traders said that despite steep rises in yen bond futures prices on Monday afternoon, MOF was unlikely to set the coupon at 2.5 percent as falls in cash bond yields were limited.
